title: studio/plugin-detail: the trackHistory toggle and buildDefaultTabs still describe a History tab the v3 record page no longer has
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 from the triage contract review of PR #27352 (comment 6494956497, ③.7), out-of-scope observation, class b, named producer. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## Observed (on `origin/main`)

PR #27352 moves the spec's `enable.trackHistory` text to the v3 record page: on the synthesized page field changes join the record's one timeline stream under its Changes filter, and there is no History tab. Three ui texts still narrate the v2 page:

1. `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts:2178-2180`: `engine.studio.settings.capTrackHistory` reads "History tab (trackHistory)", and its `…Desc` reads "Shows the read-only History tab (audit trail) on record pages". `zh.ts` ~:1990 says the same. This is the Studio toggle an author reads when turning the flag on.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:1013`: `buildDefaultTabs`'s docblock says it emits "Activity / History tabs" (and :273 names a History tab).

## Wanted

The Studio toggle's label and description say what the flag does on the v3 page, in every locale that carries the keys; the two docblocks describe the tabs `buildDefaultTabs` emits today. Text only.

## Dedupe words

capTrackHistory History tab trackHistory studio settings buildDefaultTabs docblock v3 record page
